claim_one_line: THE PRESENCE SIDE: SCOPED, ONE CONSISTENCY TEST PASSED, AND AN HONEST DEFERRAL. THE FINDING THAT CAME BEFORE THE VERIFICATION: the repo contains NO INDEPENDENT CONSTRUCTION OF M12 (the 'invisible 12'). B909's mixed leg reports the Killing-perp/invisible 12 verified with zero torus-invariance defects, full-rank charge actions, M12-meet-core = 0 and the SMT-block kernel-4 fingerprint -- but it verified that BY RUNNING THE INCOMING MATERIAL, not by rebuilding on this bench, and B909's directory ships only cmt_correct.py and results.json with no frame or M12 construction. So THE INVISIBLE 12 HAS NEVER BEEN INDEPENDENTLY CONSTRUCTED HERE -- the same shape as today's other findings: B950 found we compared against a target we never wrote down; this finds we verified data we never independently built. WHAT WAS RUN -- a genuine FRAME-INDEPENDENT test that passed: the presence side claims M12 is COLOUR-BLIND (every su(3) weight (0,0)) with dim 12, which forces M12 to sit inside the centralizer of colour su(3) in e6. Computed exactly on OUR OWN instrument (e6_centralizer.py, full Chevalley bracket table, no incoming code): dim e6 = 78, stacked ad-matrix rank over the A2 generators = 62, so DIM Z(su(3)_COLOUR) = 16 -- cross-checking against the standard structure e6 contains su(3)^3 giving Z(su(3)_C) = su(3)+su(3) = 16. Consistency requires 12 <= 16 AND IT HOLDS. This is a real constraint that COULD have failed (a colour-blind 12-dimensional space cannot exist if the colour centralizer were smaller than 12); it is NOT a verification of the presence side but one necessary condition, met. WHY THE REST IS DEFERRED RATHER THAN ATTEMPTED: a genuine verification requires independently reconstructing the frame (the orthogonal charge frame of sections XLIX-LVIII / B909), the floor (su(3) + four charges, dim 12), and M12 (the Killing-perp, dim 12), and only then testing the seven claims -- [M12,M12] escaping by exactly 4 into the torus; [floor,M12] = 12 with ZERO escape; not a module over the FMT so(10) (escape 50); centre 0; twelve multiplicity-one colour-blind weight lines; closure under exactly W_frame with three free orbits; and the orbit-generation bijection. RECONSTRUCTING THEIR FRAME WRONGLY WOULD PRODUCE A FALSE VERIFICATION OR A FALSE REFUTATION, EITHER OF WHICH IS WORSE THAN AN HONEST DEFERRAL -- this is a proper sealed cell with a substantial build, not a check foldable into another arc's tail. The presence side therefore REMAINS OWED: B946 verified section LXXXII only, B948 did not discharge it, and this arc does not either; what this arc adds is that THE DEBT IS LARGER THAN IT LOOKED (it requires a build, not a read) and that one necessary condition has now been checked against our own e6 rather than assumed. REGISTERED L135 -- BUILD THE FRAME INDEPENDENTLY: before the presence side can be verified or refuted this bench needs its OWN construction of the frame, the floor and M12; that build is worth having regardless of the presence side's fate, since it would let every future frame-arc claim be checked here instead of run from incoming code, and it closes the 'verified data we never built' gap this arc names. LIMITS: the test is necessary, not sufficient, and is stated as such; Z(su(3)_C) = su(3)+su(3) is standard while the DIMENSION 16 WAS COMPUTED HERE with the standard structure used only as cross-check; and nothing about the solo seat's claims is confirmed or denied by this arc.
